members.name: Henry Ruiz
members.bio: Creator and lead developer of PhenoWorks and LgoPy, with a research focus on leveraging the emerging capabilities of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), including reasoning, planning, and multi-agent collaboration, to streamline analytical workflows for multimodal remote sensing data. His work integrates ground-based field observations, UAV imagery, satellite data, LiDAR, and Ground Penetrating Radar (GPR) to advance scientific research automation, agricultural digital phenotyping, precision agriculture, and AI-driven data analysis.

members.name: Vijai Krishna Prasanna
members.affiliation: Texas A&M University @ Soil and Crop Sciences (SCSC)
members.bio: Vijai Krishna Prasanna is a graduate student at Texas A&M University. His research focuses on agricultural robotics and the integration of computer vision, mechatronics, edge computing, and autonomous ground-based multi-sensor platforms for high-throughput crop phenotyping and site-specific weed management.
members.position: Graduate Research Assistant in the Department of Soil and Crop Sciences

members.name: Navjot Singh
members.affiliation: Texas A&M University @ Soil and Crop Sciences (SCSC)
members.bio: Navjot Singh is a Precision Agricultural Research Associate and Ph.D. student in Soil and Crop Sciences at Texas A&M University. His research focuses on precision agriculture and the integration of machine learning, computer vision, data engineering, and drone-based imaging for weed detection, crop phenotyping, and site-specific weed management.
